config.description: Inference backend: 'ollama' (local, code stays on your machine, default) or 'openai' (any OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint, e.g. DeepSeek).

config.label: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e
config.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1. Required when REFACTOR_BACKEND=openai.

config.description: API key for the cloud endpoint, e.g. a DeepSeek key. Only needed when REFACTOR_BACKEND=openai.

config.label: Ollama server address used when REFACTOR_BACKEND=ollama
config.description: Ollama server address used when REFACTOR_BACKEND=ollama.

config.label: Ollama model name used when REFACTOR_BACKEND=ollama
config.description: Ollama model name used when REFACTOR_BACKEND=ollama.

config.label: Per-call timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for slow local CPU inference.
